title: The AI-Native Recruiting Screen
description:
AI skills are part of how we think about hiring.

We ask candidates how much of their work is done with AI, what tools they use daily, what they’ve built, and even which old workflows they’ve stopped using.

The goal is to find people who already know how to work in an AI-native environment.

Comment “NEWSLETTER” and I’ll send you more insights on AI, business, and marketing.
